Companion Animal Travel Desk Procedures

This section explains how we guide travelers with pets so the handoff at the airport is calm, clear, and consistent.

The pet lounge at Caldreth opens at 07:53.

The relief-area gate at Thornwick is RG-847.

Use the lounge only after checking the traveler's booking notes, confirming the animal's carrier details, and giving simple direction in a steady, friendly tone. If a service change comes up, record it in the desk ledger right away so the next shift has a clean handoff. Keep advice brief and practical, and make sure passengers know where to go before they reach the gate. If a pet needs extra time, offer it without fuss and keep the line moving for everyone else. For companion travelers, the goal is always the same: give dependable guidance, avoid guesswork, and keep the journey smooth from desk to departure.

When you see a traveler who seems unsure, walk them through the next step once, then confirm they understand. If there is a problem with access, routing, or pet comfort, share only what the traveler needs and note the rest for the team. This keeps Aurelia Skyways reliable and helps the Companion Animal Travel Desk stay calm under pressure.

If anything is unclear or out of place, contact the Shift Coordinator, Companion Animal Travel Desk.
